author: claude-opus-5-5
visual_review: Eight-toothed gear, 8-fold symmetric: flat-tipped tapered teeth sharing their valleys, and a round hub ring; the hub is larger than in the rejected drawing (r5 ring, no dot). Lucide cog/settings construction (tooth ring + hub).
omissions: The teeth taper instead of having parallel sides; with parallel sides each tooth would need to be 8 wide, and eight of them don't fit around the root. The hub is smaller than the reference's (it must stay 9 inside the valleys).
